summary_en: ¥1,000,000M limit; 1,300,000 shares (1.47% of shares outstanding); open-market method; Aug 1–Dec 31, 2026. Proceeds to fund restricted-stock awards to directors and employees, and strategic business initiatives.
title_en: Notice of Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Hokkaido Gas Co., Ltd. announced on 30 July 2026 that its board of directors has resolved to acquire treasury stock pursuant to the Companies Act section 459(1) and the company's articles of association section 37.

The acquisition programme is limited to 1,300,000 ordinary shares (1.47% of shares outstanding, calculated as 1,300,000 ÷ 88,273,250 ex-treasury shares) up to a total cost of ¥1,000,000 million. Purchases will be conducted via open-market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between 1 August 2026 and 31 December 2026.

The company states the shares will be used to fund restricted-stock awards to directors and employees and to support strategic business initiatives. As of 31 March 2026, the company held 415,780 treasury shares out of 88,689,030 shares issued.
